<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a relatively strong M+1 peak (~16 % of the base, indicating many 13C atoms) and a distinct M+2 peak (~4–5 % of the base, matching the natural abundance of 34S)—the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and sulfur.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
